obligations.title: Varint codec and consumed-input boundaries

obligations.owner: history-partition GC settings and read view, and fork-reference retention and release
obligations.input_scope: ReachGC: one history partition with objects L1 (committed L0), L2 (a later flush: upload, then manifest commit), C (one compaction output) and O (a fenced writer's orphan L0); one absorbed boundary over 2 offsets; one tick stands for 300 s; the compactor checkpoints the pre-compaction manifest for 3 ticks (1 tick in the timing-lapse shape); the writer Db's in-memory manifest view is refreshed within 1 tick of going stale and a production read ends within 1 tick of starting; one collector pass per tick; min_age 1 tick, writers active to tick 2, clock to 4 (small, lapse), or min_age 2, clock to 5 with one upstream checkpoint pin (expanded); liveness with writer and pin activity ending at tick 2 and weak fairness on the clock, the collector steps and the end of a read. obligations.title: Registry CAS, attempt-local outcomes, and incarnation fencing
obligations.input_scope: Two projects share one stream name (two descriptor paths). Small: M1 and M2 race generation allocations on (P1, n) incarnation E1 while D tombstones E1 and recreates the same name and key as E2; M5, validated against E2, races them on the replacement; M3 allocates on (P2, n) at E3; every E1 mutator may start before, during or after the delete and recreate; 2 attempts per call; generations <= 3; one lost PUT reply, one failed dispatch, one missing ETag, one failed GET, one client retry of an ambiguous recreate. Expanded: three E1 racers (M1, M2, M4) and two E2 racers (M5, M6) on one name, the production bound of 5 attempts, two lost replies, two failed dispatches, two missing ETags, one failed GET, one recreate retry. A conditional PUT is one request (src/bootstrap/s3_store.rs sends conditional requests with max_retries 0), so a committed PUT is never answered Precondition. Evidence properties: UniqueAllocation, IncarnationFenced, AllocatorCountsWrites, RecreateAnswerTruthful. AttemptLocalResult and NegativeOutcomesWroteNothing hold by construction (ASM-SEAL-DECIDE-FN).

obligations.title: Seal claims, renewal, and competing takeover reservations
obligations.owner: seal coordinator (application::lifecycle) and the shard committer's seal fence
obligations.input_scope: One incarnation, one segment. P0: the original product seal-with-final (two handler slots: original and exact retry); T1: a competing product seal-with-final; T2: a plain :seal. Layouts: one instance, or two instances with P0's exact retry on B while A owns the shard at start. A takeover's fence is queued at the owner: locally when the handler's process owns the shard, otherwise relayed over the fleet-internal seal-fence operation (F1-a), which can be lost before it lands (retryable) and, in a two-instance layout, can time out after it was queued (Timeout at fwait, over-approximated to every fence waiter of those layouts). Safety: generations <= 5 (<= 6 expanded) by CONSTRAINT; MaxClaimLoop = 0 (unbounded restarts, any of which may give up: a superset of the production six-iteration loop). small: 1 crash; faults: 1 registry fault, 1 cancellation, 1 enqueue failure; expanded: 1 crash, 1 registry fault; xproc: two instances, 1 crash (crash failover), 1 timeout (an append's, or a relayed fence's after it was queued); retire: 1 crash, 1 engine replacement, 1 failed fence-row read; engine: two instances, 1 crash, 1 engine replacement (a stranded head group may become durable while answered Moved), plus HandlersProgress. Baselines stage and make durable each committer element in one step (MaxHeldFence = 0), except xproc-held, retire-held and liveness-held, which separate them for one fence group: it may become durable, be lost with its engine, or be rejected without an engine retirement. Liveness (LiveSpec, one instance, no constraint, no symmetry, MaxClaimLoop = 6, weak fairness on the committer, handler steps, lease time and T2's issue): T2 retries forever; small = P0 one request, 1 crash, 1 engine replacement; contenders = P0 and T1 one request each, 1 engine replacement; faults = P0 one request, 1 registry fault, 1 enqueue failure, 1 cancellation, 1 timeout.

obligations.title: Final-record sealing, ambiguous append outcomes, and owed debt
obligations.owner: seal coordinator final-record path: raw close-with-content and product seal-with-final
obligations.input_scope: One incarnation, one segment; operation ids, producer lanes and request hashes derived from (surface, content, coordination); validity is a function of the request and the handling instance's record ceiling and ingest capacity; generations <= 5 (CONSTRAINT); MaxClaimLoop = 0. A: raw close-with-content X on client producer (L, 1), two requests; raw appends N0 = (L, 0) and N1 = (L, 1) with X's bytes; plain S; 1 crash, 1 cancellation, 1 timeout (expanded: also 1 registry fault, 1 enqueue failure). A2: X on two concurrent slots, the retry on instance B; 1 engine replacement, 1 enqueue failure; plus HandlersProgress. B: raw X (two concurrent slots) and product Y with the same bytes and different coordination, plain S. C: B with X on the product surface. P: product final X on client (L, 0), product append N1 and raw append N2 on the same tuple and bytes, plain S. SL: raw X and product Y without producer headers and with the same bytes (one synthetic lane), plain S. PW: product final X on (L, 0), product append N1 on the same tuple, raw close-with-content W admitted while X's claim stands (X's claim can be released without a lapse). V: one instance; raw X, two requests; product Y over the record ceiling; product Z refused before intent. V4: X's retry on B over B's ingest capacity. V5: X's retry on B over B's record ceiling, B owns the shard at start, 1 engine replacement, three X requests, plain S. V5A: V5 with A owning the shard at start (the original commits before the retry reaches a committer). VP: V5 for product Y. OP: raw close-with-content X and a raw append N1 without Stream-Closed, both without producer headers and with the same bytes (N1 has X's semantic operation id), plain S, 1 crash, 1 cancellation. Exact retries at every persisted boundary. Every baseline checks SealingRefusesNewAppends (L4). No TLA-003 liveness (renewal generations are unbounded).
